details.algorithm_policy: Local Python and dependency compatibility changes only; no DP algorithm or architecture modification is authorized. The source_pins check separately verifies unchanged pinned DP/OpenArm source and the sole recorded Gym installation-metadata patch.
details.local_requirements:
# Minimal standalone Week1 profile for the original image Push-T policy and
# headless OpenArm MuJoCo diagnostics. This is not the full all-benchmark Conda
# environment; it intentionally omits pytorch3d, r3m, real-robot SDKs, pi0, Ray,
# pybullet, robosuite, dm-control, and legacy mujoco-py.
#
# Exact official CPython 3.10 / Linux x86_64 / CUDA 11.6 wheels:

scope: Minimal standalone DP Week1 environment for the original image Push-T policy and headless OpenArm MuJoCo diagnostics; not a full all-benchmark, training, paper-reproduction, pi0, or real-robot environment.

storage_policy.scratch_exception: uv build/cache scratch must use local ext4 because Python virtual environment builds require symlinks that exFAT cannot create; the project-owned cache may be removed only with the installer's --clean-local-uv-cache option after successful verification.
